name: Esther
title: Esther — Hidden Hand, Open Deliverance
tagline: God not named, yet never absent.
audience: Diaspora and later Israel remembering deliverance (Purim).
purpose: Show providence preserving the people when empire threatens.
christ: Preserver of the line and people through whom Messiah comes.
spirit: Unseen governance — “for such a time as this.”
jesus_in_this_book: Preserver of the line and people through whom Messiah comes.
how_to_read: Track reversals; trust the God who hides and acts.
watchman_charge: When your moment comes, risk the throne room. Silence can be sin.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
